title: Falcons – Bears Week 6 recap: A whole lot of stumbling

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Falcons – Bears Week 6 recap: A whole lot of stumbling
sources.description: The Atlanta Falcons turned in two glorious weeks where they beat down the Packers and Saints, giving us hope they were rounding into form and becoming something more than the mediocrity we had seen for nearly a decade running. Those hopes are not entirely dashed, but they are certainly dimmed by the past two games. […]
